name: Creality CR-30 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
M117 Homing
G28 ;Home
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ;Set nozzle temp
M140 S[hot_plate_temp_initial_layer] ;Set bed temp
M190 S[hot_plate_temp_initial_layer] ;Wait for bed temp
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ;Wait for nozzle temp
M117 Purge
G92 E0 ;Reset Extruder
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ;Move Z Axis up
G1 X10.1 Y20 Z0.28 F5000.0 ;Move to start position
G1 X10.1 Y200.0 Z0.28 F1500.0 E15 ;Draw the first line
G1 X10.4 Y200.0 Z0.28 F5000.0 ;Move to side a little
G1 X10.4 Y20 Z0.28 F1500.0 E30 ;Draw the second line
G92 E0 ;Reset Extruder
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ;Move Z Axis up
M117 Printing
machine_end_gcode:
G91 ;Relative positioning
G1 E-2 F2700 ;Retract a bit
G1 E-2 Z0.2 F2400 ;Retract and raise Z
G1 X5 Y5 F3000 ;Wipe out
G1 Z10 ;Raise Z more
G90 ;Absolute positioning
G28 X0 Y0 ;Home X and Y
M106 S0 ;Turn-off fan
M104 S0 ;Turn-off hotend
M140 S0 ;Turn-off bed
M84 X Y E ;Disable all steppers but Z
